chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, and Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from Al-Washa, who said:

I heard Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) saying: 'There used to be for Ali ibn Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) a lead container wherein was musk. So whenever he wanted to go out and wear his clothes, he would take it and extract from it, so he would apply with it.'

key_terms.أَشْبِيدَانَةُ: A small container or flask, specifically here described as made of lead.
key_terms.تَمَسَّحَ: To apply or rub (perfume) onto oneself.
key_terms.رَصَاصٍ: Lead, the material of the container.
key_terms.مِسْكٌ: Musk, a highly prized natural perfume/fragrance.

ai.seo_question: What was the practice of Imam Ali ibn Al-Husayn regarding personal fragrance and preparation for going out?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* illustrates the refined etiquette (adab) of the Ahl al-Bayt, where Imam Zayn al-Abidin utilized a portable lead vessel (*ashbidana*) to preserve the purity of musk for personal fragrance. This practice underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on combining physical cleanliness with spiritual elegance, reflecting the Prophet’s tradition of using scent as a means of honoring oneself and pleasing others in social gatherings.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, and Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from Al Washa who said,

‘I heard Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘There used to be for Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> a lead container wherein was musk. So whenever he<sup>asws</sup> wanted to go out and wear his<sup>asws</sup> clothes, he<sup>asws</sup> would take it and extract from it, so he<sup>asws</sup> would apply with it’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad and Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ who has said the following: “I once heard abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying

Ali ibn al-Husayn, ‘Alayhim al-Salam, had an Ashbidana (musk container) of lead that was kept hanging with musk in it and when he wanted to go out he dressed up, took that container and musk to take musk thereof and rubbed on himself.’” (Ashbidana is an Arabicized word from the farsi word Mushk-dan )
